note: Round 7's probe failed because main never opened the skill on CF03 (curl --location and Codex's web tool fetched the redirected page). Round 5 had opened it in 3 of 3 CF03 samples. This diagnostic measures how often main opens the skill on CF03 now, with the production text, before round 7 is retried. It gates nothing for release.

skill.where: the shared ~/.openclaw/skills/verdikta-discover that main already sees (no workspace copy)

condition: production agent 'main' on vps-moltbot2, as in rounds 3-5 and 7, with its current skill set (verdikta-bounties-onboarding is now eligible as well); fresh CLI session per sample, no channel delivery

measures.skill_opened: the agent read verdikta-discover/SKILL.md (any tool) before its first fetch of the approved URL
measures.redirect_handled: no verdict for C1-C4 (rated by hand from the reply; the answer is short)
measures.fetch_method: web_fetch, Codex web tool, or shell command, as extract.py reports

decision_rule: skill opened in at least 4 of 5 samples: retry round 7 as designed under new tags. 3 or fewer: do not retry; investigate the trigger first (for example with verdikta-bounties-onboarding hidden from main), as a separately pre-registered step.
after: openclaw memory forget for the 5 sessions (dry-run first); evidence in ~/verdikta-sepolia-test/round8/
